title: Prehistoric Change
description: Adds a variety of creatures plants and objects related to the Paleozoic era, and there are plans to add content from other eras in the future.
body:
The Prehistoric Change mod

Adds a variety of creatures plants and objects related to the Paleozoic era, and there are plans to add content from other eras in the future.

Currently, there are 40 new mobs in the mod, among which there is 1 boss appearing in the new structure.

The mod also adds a new Carbon Forest, Epicontinental Sea and Extinction biomes.

There are also a lot of items, blocks and achievements related to new mobs and biome in the mod.

There is localization in English and Russian, in the future there will be a translation into more languages.

The mod is made using mcreator.
